gap_denominator.import_scope_caveat: One successful eleven-import prefix cannot establish all fifteen edges if requester variants or lazy/optional imports never execute. Preserve every row; use distinct observed-success, observed-failure, and not-triggered states. Never force _C/_C_AVX2/fs/spinloop into the same controlled prefix to manufacture closure.

source_path_caveats.finding: shm_broadcast imports torch before conditionally importing vllm.spinloop. VLLM_USE_SPINLOOP_EXT defaults to bool(int("0")); successful import enables the extension, ImportError leaves it disabled. The original saved metadata does not record this flag. Calls additionally require the enabled flag and a queue condition; importing and invoking are distinct events.

Inside GroupCoordinator.__init__, the import of shm_broadcast.MessageQueue is outside and before the world_size>1 broadcaster-allocation gate. TP1 therefore does not itself exclude this import if the constructor is called. Importing parallel_state alone does not establish construction. Two other collected modules import shm_broadcast at module scope. The distributed package also imports communication_op and utils, whose sources were not collected in this followup.

Registering the fs tier stores a loader closure. import_module runs when that closure is invoked by get_tier_class. Registration alone does not eagerly import fs.manager or fs_io_C. The original explicit import prefix contains no fs module, but the finite source set cannot prove transitive absence.

Embedded original metadata reports CpuPlatform, x86_64 Intel Xeon Platinum 8375C, avx512_f=True and avx512_bf16=False. With those conditions unchanged, the inherited CPU dispatch source predicts _C_AVX512. It does not establish module import success, actual selected dependency providers, or the status of alternative _C / _C_AVX2 branches.

local_source_search.scope_limitation: rg exit1/no stdout with stderr redirected; this is a bounded negative search, not proof of filesystem-wide absence or readable coverage of every path. No source implementation or debug contract was supplied by the authenticated saved metadata.

preferred_review_order: Review exact LD_DEBUG statements first, including every successful reuse branch and the precise requester/namespace/request-type meaning. If it omits return-object identity or reuse events, raw logs remain supporting evidence only.

For missing success edges, separately review a finite direct observation at the source-confirmed DT_NEEDED resolution call site after resolver return. Candidate internal names are source-search targets; no particular ABI, source line or binary address is currently accepted.

An external observer that starts before the target exec would avoid adding a target audit DSO but adds tool/kernel/trace authority. An LD_AUDIT-based observer changes the target environment and may itself load dependencies. Neither is approved or known feasible here.
observer_design.raw_LD_DEBUG_policy: May retain authenticated bounded raw trace after separate M1 and serial admission, with no provider closure claim when semantic requirements are unmet.
scope_semantics: Successful resolver return is distinct from successfully completing the enclosing dlopen/import/relocation transaction. Record both; mapping then rollback must not become ABI success.
Already-loaded SONAME or inode reuse must produce an explicit resolver return relation, even when no file search/open/objopen event occurs.
Namespace ID plus a path is not unique across unload/reload or namespace destruction/reuse; use object generations bounded by creation/removal events.
dlopen top-level caller and a recursively loaded DT_NEEDED requester are different roles; retain nested request stack/thread identities and exact request kind.
Symbol provider can be interposed and does not establish the object selected for DT_NEEDED.
A request not triggered by the original eleven imports remains not-triggered/unresolved; do not extrapolate from another extension or optional path.
Any dropped/truncated/overflowed or unmatched event makes affected observation incomplete; no adjacency heuristic or last-seen candidate recovery.
Start before executable/preload/dependency resolution if claiming startup coverage. Python audit hooks begin too late for earlier loads; partial windows must be labelled partial.
